fields.name: CustomerId
fields.description: IAM UserId of the cart's owner. Set from the authenticated caller on create, never from client input.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: active, abandoned, or converted (once checked out into an Order).

fields.name: Currency
fields.description: ISO currency code for all monetary fields on this cart.

fields.name: Items
fields.description: Line items currently in the cart.

fields.name: CouponCode
fields.description: Applied coupon code, if any. Revalidate against Coupon rules at checkout, not trusted as-is.

fields.name: SubTotal
fields.description: Sum of line totals before discount.

fields.name: Total
fields.description: SubTotal minus DiscountTotal. Revalidate server-side at checkout — never trust a client-computed Total for payment.

fields.name: SalesChannelType
fields.description: Ecommerce, POS, MobileApp, Marketplace, or Wholesale — which channel this cart belongs to.
